ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Carrying water and moving firewood are ordinary tasks in the daily work of a household or monastery.
EvidenceBody: Yibian names them as timely work; Tianyin asks who is carrying water and moving firewood all day; Ruibai tells listeners to farm, hoe, carry water, and move wood rather than seek elsewhere. Other records use the pair in biography and hall speech. The actions stay concrete even when a question turns on their actor.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Chan bends common labor into a public question—who performs these plainly visible acts?—without turning the labor into a hidden exercise.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Some rows are straightforward work lists or biography, not technical claims; the entry keeps that ordinary register.
